custom-fdr_day.name: FDR Day
custom-fdr_day.value_template: {% set parts = (value_json.get('manufacturer_specific') or '').split() %}{% if parts | length == 3 and parts[0] is match('^[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}$') %}{{ parts[0] | int(base=16) }}{% else %}{{ none }}{% endif %}
